t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ajëm naq'taxanneo, oh yálamxar' Dios, ye 'am ayem ad'onataq savotaique da 'am savar'ton qataq' shioqhen. Saq'taxan yetojqui naqui da iqalaxa qataq' da ad'afxaq', yachoqyic qataq' da ad'salixá. Qaica ca Iya Dios thamet Am, o-eth ia detaunaxan da souqapoiqui ca lchie, Nimaye qaica ca iben'a.
